annotations.title: Rank states for senior housing development

description: Ranks all 50 states and DC on one senior housing measure: 75+ or 85+ population, 75+ or 85+ growth since April 2020, nursing home beds per 1,000 aged 85+, assisted living beds per 1,000 aged 75+, or HUD 232 new construction loans since FY2001. Each row also carries growth, both bed ratios, certificate of need status and the state page link.

offset.description: Skip this many rows, for paging.

order.description: Highest first or lowest first. Default: lowest for the two bed ratios (thinnest supply first), highest for everything else.

name: rank_states
